subject: Finova - decision criteria follow-up: latency, deployment & SLA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finova - decision criteria follow-up: latency, deployment & SLA

Hi Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we're aligned on requirements and stakeholders.

Summary of decision criteria (from today):
- Latency: target ~100–150ms p95 for production API; evaluate p50/p95 tail behavior for embedding and chat paths.
- Deployment mode: prefer Private (VPC/on-prem options) for prod due to data residency; open to Dedicated for pilot if that speeds time-to-value.
- SLA: procurement is asking for 99.9% availability and an escalation path / credits for outages.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + KMS integration required; security review and questionnaire expected.
- Cost: want a side-by-side of Dedicated vs Private unit economics and expected monthly commit.

Stakeholders you mentioned: Michael Lang (CFO) — economic buyer; Sarah Lee (Procurement) — procurement lead; Elena Smirnova (Head of InfoSec) — security/legal reviewer. Please confirm.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm stakeholders & timeline for procurement decision (you mentioned early Nov).
2) We'll send short deployment matrix + cost delta (Dedicated vs Private) and a sample SOW. (attached: redwood-deployment-matrix.xlsx)
3) Schedule a technical deep dive with our infra team to validate latency targets and integration points (suggest: Wed Oct 14).
4) We'll share SOC2 evidence and a security questionnaire response for Elena to review.

Can you confirm the stakeholders/emails above and whether Oct 14 works for a deep dive?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-deployment-matrix.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finova.com>, Elena Smirnova <elena.smirnova@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finova - decision criteria follow-up: latency, deployment & SLA

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Confirming the stakeholder list is correct: Michael (michael.lang@finova.com) is the economic buyer and will sign off once procurement and security are satisfied.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Latency: our internal goal is to be at or under 150ms p95 for the main API path; for embeddings throughput matters too — we'll quantify batch sizes in the tech deep dive.
- Deployment: long-term we want Private (VPC) in prod. We're open to a Dedicated pilot if it shortens evaluation but need the path to Private clearly documented.
- SLA: procurement will expect 99.9%+ and a defined credit matrix. Please include standard SLA language in the SOW.

Procurement timeline: Sarah wants initial commercial terms and estimated monthly commit by the week of Oct 25; target sign-off by Nov 5. I'm attaching the procurement questionnaire that procurement will fill out and reference.

I can do the technical deep dive on Oct 14 (10:00–11:00 PT). Please include your infra/ops folks.

Appreciate the matrix — can you also send indicative pricing (monthly commit) for Dedicated vs Private?

Regards,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | Finova
alex.johnson@finova.com | +1 202-555-0199

Attachment: procurement-questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finova.com>, Michael Lang <michael.lang@finova.com>, Elena Smirnova <elena.smirnova@finova.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - decision criteria follow-up: latency, deployment & SLA

Alex — thanks, that timeline works. I've mapped stakeholders below (please correct if I missed anyone):
- Economic buyer: Michael Lang (michael.lang@finova.com)
- Procurement: Sarah Lee (sarah.lee@finova.com)
- Security/Legal: Elena Smirnova (elena.smirnova@finova.com)
- Platform/Engineering: Alex Johnson and team

Action items from our side:
- Rishi will prepare a side-by-side cost delta (Dedicated vs Private) with expected monthly commit ranges and assumptions.
- Connor will join the Oct 14 technical deep dive to validate p95 targets and batching behavior.
- I'll send a clean SOW template with standard SLA language and a link to SOC2 artifacts. (attached: SOW-template.docx)

Proposed meeting invite: Oct 14, 10:00 PT — sending the calendar now. If that's inconvenient for anyone, flag alternative times.

Next steps for you: please confirm Michael and Sarah's availability for a brief procurement sync (15–20 min) between Oct 20–23 so we can walk terms before the Oct 25 pricing milestone.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.
Marissa

Attachment: SOW-template.docx
Related link: https://app.docusign.com/link/sow-finova-2026

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Finova follow-ups & ask list

Rishi/Connor — internal checklist after Alex's reply:
1) Rishi: please produce the Dedicated vs Private cost delta by Oct 20. Include: expected commit tiers (monthly), per-token estimates, infra add-ons (KMS/HSM), and an estimated migration cost to Private. Mark assumptions clearly.
2) Connor: join Oct 14 deep dive and prep notes on p95 measurement, batching behavior, and KV/cache warm strategies. Also prepare a short runbook on what we'd need from their infra team to hit sub-150ms p95.
3) I'll coordinate SOC2 evidence and SOW SLA language.

Let me know if you need a template for the cost breakdown — I attached the deployment matrix in the external thread.

Thanks,
Marissa
